عَكِيسٌ Milk poured upon broth, (O, K,) in whatever state it [the former] be. (O.) And (O, K) Fresh milk with إِهَالَة [or melted fat, &c.,] poured upon it, after which it is drunk: (S, O, K:) or flour upon which it is poured, and which is then drunk. (A'Obeyd, TA.) ＝
-A2- Also A shoot of a grape-vine that is reversed (يُعْكَسُ) under the ground to [come forth at] another place. (S, O, K.) ―
-b2- لَيْلَةٌ عَكِيسَةٌ A dark night. (O, K.) ―
-b3- إِبِلٌ عَكِيسَةٌ Many camels. (O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
